about.subtitle: About me
about.heading: Hi Brands!
about.imageAlt: Daria sitting on a park bench in autumn light
bullets: Your product deserves content that feels natural and real, not staged. I create warm, polished UGC that shows your product the way people actually use it.
I film beauty, skincare, lifestyle and everyday routines: product demos, unboxings, tutorials, reviews and aesthetic b-roll.
My visual style is soft and light: natural daylight, cream and beige tones, clean compositions and calm, honest delivery.
Every video is shot vertically and edited to be ready for ads, Reels and TikTok, with or without voiceover and on-screen text.
